goal: Verify that a user can create a new account as the Site Host, navigate to the June 2026 calendar view, and successfully advance the calendar to the next year (2027).

findings.instruction: In the calendar view, click the right-pointing arrow button (labeled 'Next year') located in the top-right corner of the calendar header to advance the year.
findings.title: Calendar advances by month instead of year when clicking 'Next year' button
findings.description: The instruction specified clicking the 'Next year' button to advance the calendar to 2027. However, the calendar only advanced from June 2026 to July 2026 (one month forward), indicating the button performs a month increment rather than a year increment. This violates the expected behavior for a 'Next year' control.
findings.evidence: BEFORE screenshot shows 'June 2026' in the calendar header. AFTER screenshot shows 'July 2026' in the calendar header. The year did not change to 2027 as required by the test goal.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the calendar view showing June 2026.
Click the right-pointing arrow button in the calendar header (intended to advance the year).
Observe that the calendar advances to July 2026 instead of 2027.
